content.title: How to Check if PlayStation Network is DOWN or Under Maintenance on PS5 (Best Method)
content.text: If you're having trouble connecting to online games, accessing the PlayStation Store, or using other online features on your PS5, the first thing you should do is check if the PlayStation Network (PSN) is down or under maintenance. This is a quick way to rule out a problem with your own internet connection or console. Here is the best method to check the PSN status on your PS5: Method 1: The Official PS5 System Status Check This is the most accurate and direct way to see if there are any issues with the PSN. From the PS5 home screen, go to Settings (the gear icon ⚙️ in the top-right corner). Select Network. On the left-hand menu, select Connection Status. Choose View PlayStation Network Status. Your PS5 will then open a webpage that provides a detailed, real-time status of all PSN services, including: Account Management: Problems with signing in, creating accounts, or managing your profile. Gaming and Social: Issues with online multiplayer, leaderboards, and party chat. PlayStation Store: Issues with purchasing, downloading, or browsing the store. PlayStation Direct: Problems with the online store for hardware and merchandise. If any of these services are experiencing issues, they will be marked with a notification. If everything is "up and running," the problem is likely on your end. ... Twitter: https://twitter.com/YourSixStudios?la...
